name: cinematic-phone
description: Cinematic Phone video-editing style for Claude: Phone footage graded like film: wide letterbox, teal-orange tone, a serif title card and quiet subtitles. Use for travel, lifestyle, vlogs, b-roll stories, mood pieces shot on a phone. Turns a raw clip into a finished 9:16 edit with the video-studio-core engine (transcribe, auto-cut, motion graphics, sound, grade).

findings.excerpt: python CORE/scripts/run.py clip.mp4 --style STYLE --work edit-cinematic-phone --stop-after plan --title "Film title"
